name: SPT-CL J2250-4808 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J2250-4808, a rich galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj22504808-hubble
story: A rich cluster of galaxies, found by the South Pole Telescope through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect. Hubble photographed it in a survey of hundreds of such clusters, to learn how their brightest galaxies grow and how often their gravity bends the light of galaxies behind them.

claims.text: Hubble imaged it in the SPT-HST Legacy survey of clusters found by the South Pole Telescope via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
The survey studies how brightest cluster galaxies evolve and the statistics of strong lensing
Program 15307 describes it as a high-redshift, rich cluster
